rꜣ — mouth; utterance, spell (rꜣ n … "spell for …", the heading of a chapter)
ny — of (the genitive adjective; written n, fem. nt, pl. nw): rꜣ n ꜥq "spell of entering"
ꜥq — to enter, go in (r "into")
r — to, towards, into, at (preposition); with an infinitive "in order to"; with the sḏmt·f "until"; after an imperative, with a suffix (ir·k), "yourself, then"
wsḫt — broad hall, court; wsḫt mꜣꜥti "the Hall of the Two Truths"
dwꜣ — to adore, praise, worship (a god)
wsir — Osiris, god of the dead and king of the world below; Wsir N "the Osiris N", the dead person (Budge: Ausar)
ḫnty — foremost, who is at the head of (ḫnty imntt "Foremost of the West", a title of Osiris)
ḏd — to say, speak; ḏd in N "said by N", the formula that brings in a speech
in — by (naming the agent, as in ḏd in N "said by N"); (particle) it is …
sš — scribe (sš, the palette-and-pen sign); also (verb, here doubtful) to pass, go through
ꜣny — Ani, royal scribe of Thebes, for whom the papyrus was made
mꜣꜥ-ḫrw — true of voice, vindicated (said of the dead whose words were found true at the judgement)
ii — to come (ii·n·i "I have come")
sḏm·n·f — the n of the sḏm·n·f form, marking a completed action ("I have …", "I …ed"); written between the verb and its suffix
ꜥꜣ — great (adjective); (adverb) here, hither
mꜣꜣ — to see, look at
nfrw — beauty, goodness (abstract plural of nfr "good, beautiful")
·k — you, your (2nd person masculine singular suffix pronoun; the basket sign)
ꜥ — arm, hand (dual ꜥwy "the two arms")
iꜣw — praise, adoration
rn — name
mꜣꜥ — true, right, just (adjective)
ḫpr — to come into being, happen, become
ꜥš — cedar, or another conifer (its wood)
msi — to give birth; (passive) to be born
sḏmt·f — the t of the sḏmt·f form: after n "has not yet …"; after r "until …"
šndt — acacia (tree)
qmꜣ — to create, produce, bring forth
sꜣtw — ground, soil, floor
isr — tamarisk (tree)
st — place, seat, throne
štꜣ — secret, hidden; štꜣw "secret things, mysteries"
iw — particle that opens a statement, often with a suffix (iw·f "he …"); not translated
ḥnꜥ — with, together with (preposition)
stẖ — Seth, god of storm and disorder, who murdered Osiris (written stẖ or swt; Budge: Sut)
ḫnm — to smell; to be joined with; (here, doubtfully) companion, friend
tkn — to approach, draw near (tkn m "come near to")
ḥbs — to clothe, cover; clothing
ḥr — face; (preposition) upon, on, over, concerning
·f — he, him, his, it (3rd person masculine singular suffix pronoun; the horned viper)
ḫr — to fall
ḫt — thing, things, property
nty — who, which, that (relative adjective); as a noun "he who"
ḏꜣḏꜣt — council, tribunal (of gods or magistrates)
sbḫt — gateway, portal (of a temple or of the world below)
ꜣḫ — spirit, the glorified and effective dead (the crested ibis)
inpw — Anubis, the jackal god of the cemetery and of embalming (Budge: Anpu)
gs — side, half (gs·fy "his two sides")
s — man, person
iwi — to come (participle iw "coming, who comes")
tꜣ-mri — Egypt (Ta-meri)
rḫ — to know, learn (stative: "know")
wꜣt — road, way, path
·n — we, us, our (1st person plural suffix pronoun; water sign with plural strokes)
dmi — town, village, quarter
ḥtp — to be content, at peace, to rest; peace (m ḥtp "in peace"); offering
·kwi — 1st person singular ending of the stative ("I am …, I have …")
snsn — to smell, breathe (reduplicated from sn "smell, kiss")
sty — scent, smell, odour
wꜥ — one; (as a noun) one (of), someone
·tn — you, your (2nd person plural suffix pronoun)
ink — I (1st person singular independent pronoun; ink N "I am N")
ꜥnḫ — to live; life
ḥtpt — offering, food-offering (plural ḥtpwt)
imy — who/which is in (the nisba of m "in"; plural imyw)
kꜣ — ka, the life-force that receives offerings; (plural kꜣw, perhaps) food, sustenance
·sn — they, them, their (3rd person plural suffix pronoun)
wnn — to be, exist (wn·n·i "I have been"; n wn "there is not")
ḏr — limit, border, end
bꜣ — ba, soul; the Ram (the ba-ram of Mendes)
nb — lord, master, possessor (of); (adjective, after a noun) every, all
ḏdt — Mendes in the Delta (Djedet), city of the Ram (Budge: Tattu)
rdi — to give, put, place; with a sḏm·f, to cause, let (di·f pr·i "he let me come forth")
pri — to go out, come forth
bnw — the Bennu, the sun's heron of Heliopolis (the Greek phoenix)
itrw — river, the Nile
wdn — to offer, make offering
snṯr — incense (lit. "what makes divine")
sm — to go, make one's way (?) — a doubtful reading
ẖrd — child (plural ẖrdw)
ꜣbḏw — Abydos, the holy city of Osiris (Budge: Abtu)
pr-sṯt — "the House of Satet", a shrine (reading uncertain; Budge: Per-Satet)
smḥ — to sink, submerge (causative of mḥ "be drowned")
wiꜣ — boat, bark (especially of a god)
ḫfty — enemy, foe (plural ḫftyw)
ḏꜣi — to cross (water), ferry over
š — lake, pool
nšmt — the Neshmet, the sacred bark of Osiris at Abydos (Budge: neshem boat)
sꜥḥ — noble, dignitary (plural sꜥḥw)
km-wr — "the Great Black", a sacred place with a bull-cult (Budge: Qem-ur)
sgr — to silence, make quiet (causative of gr "be silent")
sḫm — power, might; sacred image, cult statue
rd — foot, leg (dual rd·fy "his two feet")
pr-tp-ḏw-f — "the House of Him who is upon his Mountain", the house of Anubis (Budge: Per-tep-tu-f)
ḥwt-nṯr — temple (lit. "mansion of the god")
pr-wsir — "the House of Osiris"; also the Egyptian name of Busiris (Budge: Per-Ausar)
kfꜣ — to uncover, strip (cf. kf) — or, here, to wrap oneself (sense uncertain)
ꜥfnt — head-cloth, the bag-shaped head-covering (plural ꜥfnwt)
im — there, therein (adverb; nty im "he who is there")
imn — to hide, conceal; to be hidden
gmi — to find
tš — boundary, district; (here, with walking legs, doubtful) a way through, passage
hꜣi — to go down, descend
n-iꜣrrd-f — An-arutef ("It does not grow"?), a holy place of Osiris (reading uncertain; Budge: An-aarut-f)
ḥꜣw — nakedness (from ḥꜣi "be naked")
ꜥntyw — myrrh, aromatic resin
šnw — circuit, circle; surrounding region
rḫyt — common folk, subjects (written with the lapwing)
mk — behold, see (particle)
nꜣ — these, those (demonstrative); "these things"
mḫꜣt — balance, scales
ḥry-ib — middle, midst (lit. "what is upon the heart"); m ḥry-ib "in the midst of"
ḥm — majesty (ḥm n N "the Majesty of N", of gods and kings)
·ti — 2nd person singular ending of the stative ("you are …, you have …"; written ·tw here)
sbꜣ — door, gate
pn — this (masculine demonstrative, after its noun)
ꜥšꜣ — many, numerous, much (the lizard sign)
ḫr-sk-šw — Kher-sek-Shu, the name of the door of the hall (meaning unclear; Budge: "Driver away of Shu")
stm — a part of a door — leaf or panel (reading and sense uncertain; Budge: setem, "leaf")
ḥry — upper, who/which is above, upon (nisba of ḥr)
ẖry — lower, who/which is beneath (nisba of ẖr)
tp — head, top; ḥry tp "who is upon"
pḥty — strength, might (nb pḥty "lord of strength")
ṯs — to tie, knot; to raise up; to marshal, command
mnmnt — cattle, herds
twk — you (2nd person masculine singular independent pronoun, a later form)
ḥsb — to reckon, count; sš ḥsb "accounting scribe"
ḥtp-nṯr — god's offerings, the offerings of a temple
wꜣst — Thebes (Waset; Budge: Uast)
imꜣḫ — honour, reverence; the honoured state of the blessed dead (nb imꜣḫ "possessor of honour")
__broaden__ n — known entry is the negative n (D35); this part also uses n (N35) as the preposition "to, for" (n·i "to me", n gs·fy "to his two sides") and once (N35) as the negative in n wn "there is not"
__broaden__ ir — known entry is the verb "to do"; this part uses ir as the particle "when, if" (ir ꜥq·i "when I entered") and apparently as a question particle (ir iw·k rḫ·tw "do you know?")
__broaden__ pr — known entry is the participle "who comes forth"; this part uses pr (O1 + stroke) as the noun "house, temple, domain" (pr wsir "the house of Osiris"); the verb itself is filed under pri
__broaden__ ḥmt — known entry is "wife, married woman"; this part has the plural ḥmwt "women"
__broaden__ m — known entry is "in, from"; this part also uses m "with" (instrument), "as" (m bnw "as the Bennu"), "on" (living on food), "by"; and im before a suffix (im·i, im·f, im·tn)
